summary: Establishes bidirectional back-references between two objects: writes this+0x1C into offset 8 of the object pointed to by this+0x20, and writes this+0x20 into offset 8 of the object pointed to by this+0x1C. Returns this+0x1C. Called from CamMan_Init (0x0040C920).

operations.description: Write the first object pointer this+0x1C into offset 8 of the second object (pointed to by this+0x20), linking the second object back to the first.
Write the second object pointer this+0x20 into offset 8 of the first object (pointed to by this+0x1C), completing the reciprocal back-reference.
Return the first object pointer this+0x1C.

unresolved: The fields at this+0x24 and this+0x28 are recorded as struct fields but are not accessed by this function.
The object type and the semantic meaning of the offset-8 back-reference slot are caller-defined.
